cards.card_text: Then the LORD gives the warning: "Behold, at this time tomorrow I will rain down the worst hail that has ever fallen on Egypt, from the day it was founded until now." A whole DAY'S notice, friend?

cards.card_text: The hail falls with the lightning flashing right through it, and nothing like it had ever been seen in all of Egypt since it became a nation.
cards.verse_text: The hail fell and the lightning continued flashing through it.
cards.snippet: The hail fell and the lightning continued flashing through it.

cards.card_text: The hail pounds the land of Egypt, but there's one place where it doesn't hail at all: the land where the Israelites live.
cards.verse_text: The only place where it did not hail was in the land of Goshen, where the Israelites lived.
cards.snippet: The only place where it did not hail was in the land of Goshen, where the Israelites lived.

cards.card_text: Pharaoh has had enough of God's thunder and hail.
cards.verse_text: Pray to the LORD, for there has been enough of God’s thunder and hail.
cards.snippet: …to the LORD, for there has been enough of God’s thunder and hail.

cards.card_text: Pharaoh even promises to let them go, and Moses says that once he's left the city, he'll spread out his hands to the LORD and the thunder and hail will stop.
cards.verse_text: Pray to the LORD, for there has been enough of God’s thunder and hail.
cards.snippet: …to the LORD, for there has been enough of God’s thunder and hail.

cards.card_text: Moses leaves Pharaoh, goes out of the city and spreads out his hands to the LORD, and the thunder and hail stop and the rain no longer pours down on the land.
cards.verse_text: The thunder and hail ceased, and the rain no longer poured down on the land.
cards.snippet: The thunder and hail ceased, and the rain no longer poured down on the land.

cards.verse_text: They will devour whatever is left after the hail and eat every tree that grows in your fields.
cards.snippet: They will devour whatever is left after the hail and eat every tree that grows in your fields.

cards.card_text: Then Isaiah takes a sudden turn: "But hail will level the forest, and the city will sink to the depths." Friend, I read that line and grabbed my gold base with BOTH ends of my mustache.
cards.verse_text: But hail will level the forest, and the city will sink to the depths.
cards.snippet: But hail will level the forest, and the city will sink to the depths.

cards.card_text: In His wrath He'll release a windstorm, and in His anger torrents of rain and hail will fall with destructive fury.
cards.verse_text: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: In My wrath I will release a windstorm, and in My anger torrents of rain and hail will fall with destructive fury.
cards.snippet: …will release a windstorm, and in My anger torrents of rain and hail will fall with destructive fury.

cards.verse_text: I struck you—all the work of your hands—with blight, mildew, and hail, but you did not turn to Me, declares the LORD.
cards.snippet: I struck you—all the work of your hands—with blight, mildew, and hail, but you did not turn to Me, declares the LORD.
